newsitem.title: USA: B.O.S says 1st half 96 revenues up 46 pct.
newsitem.headline: B.O.S says 1st half 96 revenues up 46 pct.

text.p: B.O.S. Better Online Solutions Ltd said on Tuesday its revenues increased 46 percent to $3.45 million in the first half of 1996 from the same period last year, boosted by sales of emulation and connectivity products.

"We are very pleased with the high volume of sales of our emulation products and connectivity technologies in the United States, and with the substantial rise in net income, despite higher expenses caused by becoming a public company," B.O.S. President Israel Gal said in a statement.
